comments: I think there was a group of 6 or so, I only got good eyes on 1.

Searched for about an hour for the reported 2 birds. Eventually I disturbed one from the grass/saltmarsh edge, it called with the harsh trrt trrt call and flew away from me at first at quite a low height, giving views of the streaked back, and warmer brown patches in the wings. A fairly bulky bunting not the slim long tailed look of reed bunting. And call was diagnostic. It went to ground about 100m ahead of me but I could not relocate it.
